# Velair 1.9.0-beta.8

## 🚀 Improved

- Reduced repeated schedule, Room Assist and Comfort calculations when entities, diagnostics and API readers observe the same update. Velair prepares reusable schedules and targets per zone, including Planned Return resources, while checking current inputs and execution authority before climate commands. Thanks to **@lorenzosp93** for the report, profiles and workaround in [issue #62](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/62).
- Expanded regression coverage and isolated Home Assistant responsiveness measurements, including sustained temperature reports and unrelated light actions.

## 🧭 Notes

- This beta follows [1.9.0-beta.7](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/releases/tag/v1.9.0-beta.7) and is intended for installation-level validation of the performance changes. Diagnostic notifications retain their existing timing; this beta does not add a fixed five-second event cache or a two-second diagnostics delay.
- Tests use real Home Assistant 2025.3.4 with virtual devices. Controlled comparisons show less repeated work and lower CPU use, but delays of hundreds of milliseconds remain. These results do not establish that this version outperforms the reporter's local workaround or resolves the issue on the reported installation.
- No configuration-format change is introduced relative to beta.7. An upgrade from 1.8.0 also includes the earlier 1.9 beta changes; keep a pre-update backup if you may downgrade. After updating through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser or Companion app.
